column3: The Hebrew names rivers and uses an uncompleted verb for establishing; BSB has waters and established.
The Hebrew wording has my soul and vanity; BSB has his soul and an idol.
The Hebrew says bear a blessing; BSB says receive blessing.
The Hebrew names Jacob without explicitly adding God of as BSB does.
The Hebrew calls them doors of eternity; BSB says ancient doors.
The Hebrew’s second command is active lift up; BSB uses be lifted up.
